name: stacksanarchy
description:
StacksAnarchy is a fun anarchy server that anyone can play!

Have fun doing whatever you want. You can be a builder, build amazing structures. Wherever, and whenever you want, you can be a gatherer going and getting and trading materials, or you can be a destroyer, creating giant lava casts and blowing up everywhere around spawn and the entire server. It is completely vanilla. Have fun and do whatever you would like! (Utility clients premeditated)
